content: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 11 月 9 日，本网获悉：湖北人权捍卫者尹旭安至今强迫失踪已近 1 年 3 个月。尹旭安的朋友近日收到署名尹旭安的求救信，信里说其被“关押在黄石市黄金山开发区黄石市宇祥精神病医院”。其友人经过了解确认，应为黄石市精神病医院（也叫黄石精神卫生中心优抚医院）。 网查地址：湖北省黄石市黄金山工业新区汪仁镇金山大道东 698 号。 医院总机： 0714-6357337。    医务室： 0714-6366300  尹旭安自 2007 年起参与维权，长期参与围观声援等抗争行动，多次遭拘留、劳教、关黑监狱；曾两次入狱，刑期累计八年此后失联。尹旭安患有随时可能危及生命的极高危高血压，肾动脉瘤、多发性脑梗死、脑积水、高血压性心脏病伴心力衰竭等多种严重疾病， 2025 年 8 月 11 日，他带着转院单到北京试图到专科医院医治，却在北京救护车 120 担架上被黄石市保安镇政府人员徐跃飞（网上大冶政府公示栏里显示其目前是人大代表，电话 13092759825 ）带队劫持，自此遭强迫失踪，家属及律师多次寻找无果。 尹旭安曾遭判刑 4 年 6 个月，狱中境况及身体就很差，刑满释放后又被非法拘禁 1 年 4 个多月后被才释放回家，其经历用四个字“生不如死”形容，身体状况特别差。尹旭安重病在身，极高危高血压，血压最高时达到高压 300/ 低压 220 ，冠心病严重，急需做手术。尹旭安去北京纯属病情严重去看病，竟然中共当局屡遭到拦截，对其强迫失踪非法关押至今，这是对其生命健康权的严重践踏。 尹旭安简介： 1974 年 8 月 27 日出生，湖北省大冶市人，原湖北省大冶市保安镇村民，公益维权公民，民主人士，政治犯。 2003 年，曾因控告湖北省鄂州市梁子湖区民政局就其夫妻离婚争议非法登记一案，被地方法院枉法裁判，而地方高院对此又不作为，随被迫于 2007 年到北京上访； 自 2007 年 11 月以来，因多次上访而备受当局非法处罚及伤害；曾因上访维权和参与围观、声援、抗争行动而被当局非法拘留 6 次、被关黑监狱 8 次； 2009 年，在美国时任总统奥巴马访华期间，曾因到北京市公安局治安总队申请游行示威，而被湖北当局处以劳动教养 2 年，并延期释放 3 个月；劳教期间，曾因身患高血压三期（极高危程度）及多种其他疾病（如乙肝、胆囊炎及结石等）而多次晕倒和急救； 2012 年起，曾因在京维权，开始更多关注民主公益维权事业； 2012 年，曾积极参与十八大民主直选学术代表，呼吁推进政治体制改革、废除劳教制度及打击黑监狱等； 2012 年 7 月— 10 月，曾因举报和起诉湖北省当地政府非法征用土地、起诉湖北省劳教委非法延期及非法选举等问题，而遭当局非法拘禁 42 天； 2013 年始，开始积极介入声援围观行动，如江西新余刘萍独立候选人案、山东曲阜薛福顺事件、山东淄博孙峰“煽颠案”、 4.29 祭奠林昭活动、湖南衡阳赵枫生“煽颠案”开庭、郑州十君子事件、焦作张小玉案、苏州老兵范木根血拆案开庭、与王福磊等维权网友声援维权公民王健案等。 2015 年 3 月 8 日，曾因用微信转发“湖北大冶市驻京维稳人员名单”而遭当局抓捕，并被行政拘留 15 天， 3 月 24 日被以涉嫌“泄露国家机密罪”刑拘，后被释放； 2015 年 7 月 25 日，又因与王芳、耿彩文等维权人士在武汉市黄鹤楼前身着声援屠夫（吴凎）的文化衫，并拍照上传网媒，随于 7 月 28 日被警方从家中带走，拘留于大冶市保安镇派出所，同年 8 月 23 日被转为刑拘； 9 月 26 日，被以涉嫌“寻衅滋事罪”批捕； 2016 年 9 月 13 日，其案在湖北省大冶市法院开庭受审，至 2017 年 5 月 27 日被该法院以“寻衅滋事罪”判处有期徒刑 3 年 6 个月；关押期间，曾遭狱警和牢头狱霸酷刑殴打，身心俱毁，且多次要求会见律师遭拒； 2018 年 12 月 27 日，被减刑提前释放，但在出狱后不久的中共两会期间又被湖北省大冶市警方以涉嫌“故意泄露国家机密罪”刑拘，且遭虐待，直至 2019 年 1 月才获释放； 2019 年 5 月 23 日，尹旭安因大冶市保安镇政法委书记袁启发，及金塘村党支记兼村长尹青松等人，在金塘村尹四房湾村民都没同意的情况下，不仅强行量了集体所有的、赖以生存的土地，并把挖掘机开到现场实施强征的不法行为而信访维权，然后就遭到一次次的打击报复，又被以涉嫌“寻衅滋事罪”刑拘； 2019 年 10 月，其案被大冶市检察院起诉至地方法院； 2020 年 1 月 19 日，其案被湖北省大冶市法院虽开庭审理，久拖至 2021 年 7 月 21 日终被该法院以“寻衅滋事罪”判处有期徒刑 4 年 6 个月，刑期至 2023 年 11 月 22 日；据悉，其在狱中身体状况极差，已被抢救数次。尹旭安案二审 2022 年 1 月 28 日宣判维持原判四年半。此前在黄州监狱服刑。 对尹旭安的境况，本网将持续关注。

title: 銀行倒閉拖垮總統：巴拉圭政局動盪如何牽動美中台角力？｜Whatsnew
summary: 11月3日，巴拉圭客戶數最多的Ueno銀行爆發金融危機倒閉，影響近300萬人口無法從帳戶中領取存款，民眾憤怒上街抗議。事件爆發後，總統潘尼亞（Santiago Peña）因與該銀行關係密切，6日遭到巴拉圭參議院全票通過彈劾並隨即遭到軟禁，總統一職由副總統、52 歲保守派政治人物阿里亞納（Pedro Alliana）宣誓接任。 巴拉圭的政權移轉與金融醜聞引發國際關注。巴拉圭是南美洲唯一目前仍與台灣維持正式邦交的國家，長期與北京保持距離，而前總統潘尼亞又與美國特朗普政府關係密切。
content: 11月3日，巴拉圭客戶數最多的Ueno銀行爆發金融危機倒閉，影響近300萬人口無法從帳戶中領取存款，民眾憤怒上街抗議。事件爆發後，總統潘尼亞（Santiago Peña）因與該銀行關係密切，6日遭到巴拉圭參議院全票通過彈劾並隨即遭到軟禁，總統一職由副總統、52 歲保守派政治人物阿里亞納（Pedro Alliana）宣誓接任。 巴拉圭的政權移轉與金融醜聞引發國際關注。巴拉圭是南美洲唯一目前仍與台灣維持正式邦交的國家，長期與北京保持距離，而前總統潘尼亞又與美國特朗普政府關係密切。近年來，美中在南美洲的外交與經貿競爭日趨激烈，中國持續擴大對該地區的投資與貿易影響力，積極爭取巴拉圭轉向，將之視為切斷台灣在南美最後據點的關鍵一步。因此，巴拉圭政局動盪是否牽動其對台、對中政策，也成為地緣政治觀察的焦點。 新任總統阿里亞納上台之後，美國國務卿魯比奧（Marco Rubio）也 祝賀 其接任總統，並稱美國致力於與巴拉圭人民建立牢固持久的伙伴關係；台灣外交部發言人蕭光偉也表示，台巴關係良好，巴拉圭的政局改變不會影響兩國邦誼，將擇期邀請新總統赴台。 2026年11月9日，巴拉圭首都亞松森，透過在抗議政府和Ueno Bank的示威中被砸碎的窗戶，可以看到Ueno Bank關閉後的辦公室內部。攝：Jorge Saenz/AP/達志影像 銀行倒閉引發的政治危機 綜合 美聯社 與 路透社 報導，11月3日，巴拉圭中央銀行決定將Ueno銀行置於破產管理程序之中，理由是該銀行償債能力比率（衡量資本與風險加權資產比率的指標）已跌至法定最低標準的一半以下。根據該銀行資料，Ueno擁有約近300萬客戶，占巴國650萬成年人口的六成；並管理8億至8.5億美元的公共資金。其中包括巴拉圭國家退休和醫療基金投資的約3.8億美元。 巴拉圭檢調第一時間下令逮捕該銀行的高層，包含 Ueno銀行的行長以及CEO一共八人。時任總統潘尼亞在第一時間 表示 ，已經要求巴國央行行長Carlos Carvallo辭職，並加速對客戶及公共資金的返還。他在社群媒體上發布貼文表示：「所有責任人都必須接受法院的審判，沒有任何例外或特權。」 然而，潘尼亞與Ueno銀行的母集團Grupo Vázquez的關係一直遭受質疑，他長期持有Vázquez的股份，直到2025年3月才售出； Carlos Carvallo的職務也是由潘尼亞所任命，他此前正是Ueno銀行的行長，此舉曾被控違反利益迴避原則。 根據 半島電視台 報導，Ueno銀行成立於1976年，本來在巴拉圭屬於小型金融機構，但在潘尼亞上任以後取得正式銀行執照，並進行了品牌重塑，在五年內迅速發展成為擁有70多家分行的銀行。 巴拉圭媒體《ABC Color》 報導 ，Ueno銀行遭到調查，起因為監管人員發現，該銀行向其母集團Grupo Vázquez的相關公司發放了1.46億美元的高風險貸款，且帳務的計算有誤，在校正過後發現緩衝資金不足法定限額的一半。 潘尼亞在上任前是國際貨幣基金（IMF）的經濟學家，巴拉圭也憑藉著近年來的低稅收、寬鬆的監管和穩定的經濟記錄吸引了外國投資者，2024年首次獲得信評機構穆迪（Moody’s）的投資級信用評級。自上任以來，潘尼亞也將自己塑造成國家與執政黨的改革者。他所屬的全國共和協會（Asociación Nacional Republicana），通常被稱為紅黨（Colorado Party），該黨自1947年以來長期執政，僅於2008年至2013在野，前後累計執政74年。 金融危機爆發後不久的11月5日，潘尼亞透過社群媒體 宣布 辭職，報導 指出 ，潘尼亞失去了紅黨重要領袖、參議員也是前總統的卡提斯（ Horacio Cartes ）支持；先前潘尼亞是在卡提斯的推舉之下參選總統。然而即便主動辭職，參議院仍舊選擇完成總統彈劾程序。最後在6日，巴國參議院以44:0（參議員共45人，1人缺席）通過潘尼亞的彈劾案，讓這位前總統喪失終身參議員的資格，以及刑事豁免權。 在彈劾程序通過以後，副總統阿里亞納宣誓繼任總統，潘尼亞也隨即被軟禁。 報導 指出，他被控利用總統職權，將數百萬美元政府存款存入Ueno；儘管已被告知這家銀行有可疑放款及償付能力問題，他仍隱瞞或淡化該行的財務困境。 另外，潘尼亞位於首都亞松森郊外的豪宅也遭到調查。潘尼亞2024年向該行成功申請2筆貸款，總額約50萬美元，用於興建這棟住宅；潘尼亞每月房貸還款金額高達3萬8000美元，相當於他擔任總統月薪的6倍。 2026年11月4日，巴拉圭首都亞松森，民眾在警察面前抗議政府和 Ueno Bank 。Ueno Bank因償付能力危機而被巴拉圭中央銀行接管。攝：Jorge Saenz/AP/達志影像 潘尼亞所面臨的指控還包含洗錢、資產來源不明（Illicit enrichment）、操弄金融監管機制、挪用退休基金等罪名，但潘尼亞本人否認一切不法的指控。 法新社 報導，阿里亞納上任以後，承諾不會放棄近300萬受上野銀行收購影響的儲戶，包括領退休金的人。並陸續在5日開始有條件發放「補償金額」；然而根據報導，是否能完全返還所有款項，以及資金來源等問題都未能釐清，也引起懷疑。 這場金融危機讓數千人走上街頭抗議，甚至連巴拉圭的足球也受到影響，因為Grupo Vázquez集團是多支球隊乃至於國家隊的主要贊助商，該國在阿根廷的分公司也停職30天且不支薪。 巴拉圭居民的反應 巴拉圭居民Lucía（化名）接受《端傳媒》訪問時表示，雖然自己沒有受到這次事件的影響，但巴拉圭社會整體相當驚嚇與手足無措。她認為，即便政府正在努力償還Ueno銀行留下的債務，但金額太過龐大，政府難以完全付清。 「潘尼亞與Grupo Vázquez需要出面負責，尤其如果潘尼亞的貪汙罪名確定——說實在的，也很難讓人相信潘尼亞沒有貪汙，他的支出是當總統月薪的六倍。」Lucía說。 她也提到，這起事件不只影響帳面上近300萬名儲戶那麼簡單——還包括失業的銀行人員、整個國家的商業活動等。她舉例，在她工作的地方，所有的商業合作案、專案計畫等已經全部暫停。 更嚴重的是，Lucía認為人民很難再次建立對政府的信任。這並非巴拉圭第一次有銀行倒閉，上一次是在1990年代末期到2000年初。此外，巴拉圭近年來是快速成長的經濟體，「外國的投資者如何有信心到巴拉圭投資？政府已經喪失了信用（Credibility），不只是外國資本，還有巴拉圭國民。」 至於會不會影響到2028總統選舉，她認為會，也希望會。「巴拉圭人也要想一想，我們已經被The Partido Colorado（紅黨）執政太久，但他們卻不斷貪汙，包含卡提斯、以及潘尼亞。」 2026年1月22日：美國總統特朗普在瑞士達沃斯舉行的第56屆世界經濟論壇期間，與巴拉圭總統潘尼亞在加薩和平憲章簽署儀式上握手。攝：Harun Ozalp/Anadolu via Getty Images 政治動盪成地緣政治焦點 根據《金融時報》 報導 ，潘尼亞是川普的堅定盟友之一。2024年，時任參議員的魯比奧曾經公開讚賞巴拉圭是南美洲的「榜樣」。川普也在上任之後，取消了前任總統拜登（Joe Biden）對巴拉圭前總統卡提斯所實施的制裁。制裁原因包括妨礙跨國犯罪調查、侵蝕民主制度、與真主黨有往來等。美國政府拒絕卡提斯與其子女入境，也凍結他在美國的資金與財產。 CNN 報導 指出，潘尼亞有許多施政措施都與川普保持一致，尤其在移民與安全問題的層面。潘尼亞曾透過國防和區域協調的協議與川普政府建立了牢固的關係，例如允許將來自美國的尋求庇護者轉移到巴拉圭的「安全第三國」協議。 美國「第三國遣返」計畫曝光：2.5萬移民被送往何處、又遭遇什麼？ 巴黎非營利新聞組織報導，特朗普第二屆政府快速擴大的「第三國遣返」網絡，如何將至少2.5萬移民送往原籍國以外的國家。遣送程序多有缺失，也可能違反國際法「不遣返原則」特朗普政府已與35個國家促成此類協議，至少投入4.1億美元。 美國與中國近年來在南美洲有激烈的外交競爭，已有多家研究機構包含 Brookings Institution 、 Council on Foreign Relations （CFR）的研究表明，中國在南美洲的經濟影響力已經超過美國，選擇與中國保持距離的巴拉圭，有其政治意義與獨特性。 專注於研究美洲地緣政治的非營利組織Global Americans執行長Diego Area 分析 指出，近期美巴關係大多依賴川普與潘尼亞的私人關係，巴拉圭政府也可以藉此表明雙邊關係並非僅有政治層面，而是在反貪腐層面上進行主動的合作，包括主動提供Ueno銀行案件的資訊。 巴拉圭政治顧問Sebastian Acha則認為，這起事件讓卡提斯重新在紅黨掌權，與美國維持關係的大方向會維持不變，但仍需觀察是否變成紅黨的政治清洗，以及2028總統大選前內部權力紛爭。而值得讚許的是，巴拉圭在24小時內讓總統下台，完成和平的權力交接，並未有軍事干預，這讓巴拉圭的盟友打消一定程度的疑慮。 巴拉圭與台灣 台灣與巴拉圭於1957年建交至今，雙方互設大使館。巴拉圭的長期執政黨立場親台，潘尼亞本人在2023年當選後，3年內已經訪台3次，最近一次是2026年5月。台灣也與巴拉圭有許多合作計畫，並採購農牧產品，根據外交部 資料 ，台灣目前是巴拉圭牛肉出口的第二大貿易夥伴、豬肉外銷的第一大採購國。 2026年5月8日，巴拉圭總統潘尼亞到訪台灣，與台灣總統賴清德一起出席歡迎儀式。攝：Ann Wang/Reuters/達志影像 然而，在台灣與中國的外交競爭下，邦交國每到選舉時，外交是否應該轉向中國都會成為討論焦點之一。2023年，潘尼亞的競爭對手、反對派候選人 Efraín Alegre就數度在接受媒體 訪問 時，主張要重新檢視與台灣的關係，並考慮與中國建立外交關係，原因是巴國的農牧業無法進入中國市場。 中國對於巴拉圭國會議員的拉攏手段也從未停歇，路透社3月的調查 指出 ，自2023年底以來，至少有19名巴拉圭國會議員、5名記者，以及一名具有總統參選意向的反對派政治人物訪問中國，且2025年訪問活動明顯增加，並且執政黨與在野黨都有人士參與。 對於巴拉圭政權交接後的後續情形，台灣外交部發言人蕭光偉 回應 ，巴國政情發展不會影響兩國邦誼及相關合作推動，新任總統阿里亞納堅定支持台灣，在擔任副總統與眾議院議長期間，多次公開重申台灣是巴拉圭重要戰略盟友。 阿里亞納原訂於11月24日訪問台灣，蕭光偉也說明，因情勢關係，阿里亞納就任總統，在此情況下會優先處理國政，後續會擇適當時機，再邀請他來台。 蕭光偉也說明，台灣在當地的援助計畫與業務往來的合作經費並未受到Ueno銀行倒閉影響，業務一切正常。

title: Most affairs don't matter except to the people involved. Ex- Nvidia CEO Jensen's blunder will rock the world
zh_title: 大多数事情除了对相关人员而言并不重要。英伟达前首席执行官詹森的错误将震惊世界
summary: 这是一个与时间一样古老的故事。亿万富翁书呆子男孩遇见女孩。女孩后来被怀疑是间谍。 11 点的消息。哦，还有报道称他与一名直接下属的员工有染。当英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋犯下“浪漫”错误时，他不会半途而废。世界上最有价值的公司的老板——好吧，无论如何，直到最近——昨天，11 月 12 日公开辞去了首席执行官、总裁和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。我们不知道他是跳下去的还是被推的。他在承认有外遇后离开了。虽然他从来不
content:
这是一个与时间一样古老的故事。亿万富翁书呆子男孩遇见女孩。女孩后来被怀疑是间谍。 11 点的消息。哦，还有报道称他与一名直接下属的员工有染。当英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋犯下“浪漫”错误时，他不会半途而废。世界上最有价值的公司的老板——好吧，无论如何，直到最近——昨天，11 月 12 日公开辞去了首席执行官、总裁和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。我们不知道他是跳下去的还是被推的。他在承认有外遇后离开了。尽管他从未指定过外遇对象，但据报道，其中一件事是与黄乐（又名黄乐）发生的。她是中国公司 Megaspeed 的负责人，该公司是 Nvidia 的合作伙伴。 Megaspeed 被指控为中国政府的幌子，用于将 Nvidia 芯片转移到中国，尽管这一点尚未得到证实。一些美国官员还怀疑 [PDF] 她为中国情报部门工作，尽管美国司法部表示尚未就此得出结论。当《纽约时报》报道称詹森还与英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔有染时，压垮了詹森的棺材。哎呀，伙计！此后，英伟达首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 被任命为临时首席执行官。我怀疑她不会在这个岗位上呆太久。首席财务官不是首席执行官。这些工作根本不一样。在大多数公司中，黄仁勋将被首席运营官取代。这不可能发生在这里。
Nvidia 没有 COO。无论是在 Nvidia 内部还是外部，黄仁勋都被视为 Nvidia，Nvidia 也被视为黄仁勋。如今，亿万富翁首席执行官被视为无所不知、统治一切的神王。很多时候，这都是废话。英伟达的情况并非如此。黄仁勋于 1993 年 4 月 5 日与他人共同创立了 Nvidia。他在第一天就被任命为首席执行官，此后从未离开过这个职位。起初，公司步履蹒跚。当它于 1999 年发布 GeForce 256 并将其作为首款 GPU 进行营销时，它开始走上成为 PC 游戏玩家首选芯片制造商的道路。今天仍然如此。这是一个巨大的利基市场，但它并不能让一家公司成为价值数万亿美元的企业。不，当 2006 年 Nvidia 推出 CUDA 时，就达到了令人眼花缭乱的高度。这种编程架构向科学和其他非图形工作负载开放了 GPU 的并行处理能力。从那时起，CUDA 将成为大多数高性能和人工智能计算的基础。黄是这一切的中心。直到现在他还是这样。在 KubeCon 北美（Kubernetes 的贸易展）上，超过一半的人工智能项目都使用了 Kubernetes，我与许多 Nvidia 员工进行了交谈。他们都提到了两件事。首先，他们处于震惊状态。也许中美高层和政府官员都知道黄在玩火；我采访过的普通开发人员对此一无所知。
第二个是，黄仁勋每个月都会召开一次全体员工大会，他不是一场形式上的企业动员大会，而是回答每个人的问题，并给他们真正的答案。他很了解自己的技术，并且真正领导着他的公司，而不是仅仅给容易上当的股票买家留下深刻的印象。英伟达无法取代他。实在不行啊。我想起了 1985 年约翰·斯卡利 (John Sculley) 迫使史蒂夫·乔布斯 (Steve Jobs) 离开苹果公司的情景。如果你还没有老到记得的话，苹果公司曾一度表现不错，但到了 90 年代中期，它就迷失了方向。乔布斯下台后，苹果公司重新焕发了魔力，并开始崛起为世界顶级公司之一。

【原文 English Original】
It's a story as old as time. Billionaire nerd boy meets girl. Girl is later suspected of being a spy. News at 11. Oh, and it's also been reported that he was having an affair with one of his direct-report employees. When Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang makes a "romantic" blunder, he doesn't do it halfway. The boss of the world's most valuable company – well, it was until recently, anyway – publicly resigned yesterday, November 12, as CEO, president, and board member, effective immediately. We don't know if he jumped or if he was pushed. He left after admitting to having an affair. Although he never named an affair partner, one of the affairs was reported to be with Alice Huang, AKA Huang Le. She's head of the Chinese company Megaspeed, which was an Nvidia partner. Megaspeed is accused of being a front for China's government that was used to transfer Nvidia chips to China, although this hasn't been proven. Some US officials also suspect [PDF] she's working for Chinese intelligence, although the DoJ said it hasn't yet reached a conclusion about this. The final nail in Jensen's coffin came when The New York Times reported he had also allegedly had an affair with Nvidia's VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. Jeeze, guy! In the aftermath, Nvidia's CFO, Colette Kress, was appointed interim CEO. She won't, I suspect, be in the job for long. CFOs are not CEOs. The jobs aren't remotely the same. In most companies, Huang would be replaced by the COO. That can't happen here. Nvidia doesn't have a COO. Both inside and outside of Nvidia, Huang is seen as Nvidia, and Nvidia as Huang. These days, billionaire CEOs are perceived as God-kings who know all and rule all. Much more often than not, that's BS. That isn't the case with Nvidia. Huang co-founded Nvidia on April 5, 1993. He was appointed CEO on day one, and he never left the job. At first, the company staggered forward. When it released the GeForce 256 in 1999 , which it marketed as the first GPU, it started on its path to becoming the chip manufacturer of choice for PC gamers. It still is today. That's a great niche, but it doesn't make a company a trillion-dollar business. No, the path to that dizzying height came when, in 2006, Nvidia unveiled CUDA . This programming architecture opened its GPUs' parallel-processing capabilities to scientific and other non-graphics workloads. From there, CUDA would become the foundation for most high-performance and AI computing. Huang was at the center of it all. He still was until now. At KubeCon North America , the trade show for Kubernetes, used in well over half of all AI projects, I spoke to many Nvidia employees. There were two things they all mentioned. First, they were in a state of shock. Maybe the top brass and government officials both in China and the US knew Huang was fooling with fire; the developer rank-and-file folks I spoke to hadn't had a clue. The second was that every month, Huang held an all-hands meeting where, instead of a per-forma corporate pep rally, he answered questions from everyone and gave them real answers. He knew his technology well and actually led his company instead of just impressing gullible stock buyers. Nvidia can't replace him. It really can't. I'm reminded of when John Sculley forced Steve Jobs out at Apple in 1985. If you're not old enough to remember, Apple did fine for a while, but then by the mid-90s, it lost its way. Apple got its mojo back, and started its rise to being one of the world's top companies only after Jobs came back in 1996 . The big difference, of course, is that Huang's not coming back. I heard many people say that Huang was "too big to fail." True, morality no longer matters much in the US – see Trump's kleptocracy – but this is different. Huang betrayed not just his wife, but his board, employees, and stockholders. If, as some suspect, the board knew full well what was going on, they should be tossed out too, but that's a story for another day. Oh, and as for Trump's suggestions that Apple's former CEO Tim Cook should become Nvidia's CEO? Give me a break. Now the question of the day is: how can Nvidia recover from this blow? I don't think it can. I used to say that I didn't know where the AI companies were going, but I was sure that so long as capital kept flowing into Big AI, Nvidia was the one company you could count on that would make money . I think I was wrong. What does that mean? In the short term, Nvidia stock, after dropping 14 percent in early trading on Thursday, is down "only" five percent. Despite all the Sturm und Drang over Huang's departure, the NASDAQ is actually, when I wrote this, up. Even Nvidia's bonds are holding steady . Amazon and Google, which have their own horses in the AI TPU races, are hoping, of course, that Nvidia's misfortune will help them lever open the AI hardware market. In these early hours, I don't see that happening. Frankly, I'm amazed at how stockowners are shaking off Huang's resignation. The AI fever dream, for now, is continuing unabated. That said, can this go on? This irrational exuberance rests on the belief that, no matter what happens, AI will continue to rule the stock market. Eventually, though, the bubble may pop, and that could put some strain on the global economy. For now, people are ignoring how bad this blow is, or perhaps they're not aware of it. In a few years, I expect Huang's affair will be seen as the first needle in the AI bubble. ®

title: Singapore says US authorities, and Supermicro, hardly helped investigation of Jensen Huang’s Chinese friend
zh_title: 新加坡称美国当局和超微几乎没有帮助调查黄仁勋的中国朋友
summary: 新加坡内政部政府透露，他们对 Alice Huang 进行了调查，这名女子据称是中国情报人员，与英伟达前首席执行官 Jensen Huang 关系密切，并可能与陷入困境的服务器制造商 Supermicro 存在纠葛。尽管新加坡寻求帮助，但美国当局仅在此事上提供了“有限的援助”。该部在新加坡时间周四晚些时候发表的一份声明中概述了其活动。文件显示，新加坡警察部队（SPF）和海关机构已开始对华女士展开调查
content:
新加坡内政部政府透露，他们对 Alice Huang 进行了调查，这名女子据称是中国情报人员，与英伟达前首席执行官 Jensen Huang 关系密切，并可能与陷入困境的服务器制造商 Supermicro 存在纠葛。尽管新加坡寻求帮助，但美国当局仅在此事上提供了“有限的援助”。该部在新加坡时间周四晚些时候发表的一份声明中概述了其活动。文件显示，新加坡警察部队 (SPF) 和海关机构于 2025 年 2 月开始对黄女士的公司 Megaspeed 进行调查。该部写道，“涉嫌的国内犯罪行为涉及购买服务器和其他相关犯罪行为的潜在虚假申报”，并补充说，该高管“并未因间谍活动而受到调查”。新加坡当局想知道本地公司购买的服务器在未接触新加坡领土的情况下出口到马来西亚，是否可能最终流向第三国。对于总部位于新加坡的公司来说，购买从未到达该岛的货物并不罕见，因为新加坡将自己宣传为经营亚洲贸易业务的理想地点。新加坡这样做是因为它很小——整个国家的面积与纽约市的五个行政区一样大。新加坡的面积较小，意味着它限制了在其领土上运行的数据中心的数量。
这些限制是马来西亚柔佛地区成为主要数据中心省份的一个重要原因。柔佛地区距离新加坡边境不到 20 公里，是一个联合经济特区。新加坡需要这样的交易才能繁荣发展，但会努力确保其热情好客不被滥用。这就是为什么它认为 Megaspeed 的活动值得调查。美国当局也很感兴趣。 2025 年 6 月 24 日，负责监管受出口管制的敏感商品的工业安全局访问了新加坡的 Megaspeed，检查其购买的硬件是否已抵达预定目的地。黄女士出席了该活动，随后接受了SPF的采访。那次会议以 SPF 扣押了她的护照而告终，这样在调查继续进行期间她就可以留在新加坡。随着事件的进展，SPF 怀疑长期陷入困境的服务器制造商 Supermicro 在这起事件中扮演了角色。读者可能还记得，美国司法部起诉了两名超微高管，罪名是合谋向中国运送服务器，违反了美国法律。超微对此事进行了调查，并与三名行为不当的员工分道扬镳。该公司否认曾向 Megaspeed 出售过产品。新加坡当局表示，他们只得到了 Supermicro 的“有限合作”，因此该国总检察长办公室于 2025 年 7 月向美国当局寻求帮助。
声明透露：“自 2025 年 9 月以来，SPF 已多次向美国司法部和联邦调查局重复这一请求。尽管一再提出请求，但新加坡迄今为止收到的有关该公司的信息或援助有限。” 2026 年 2 月，SPF“得出结论，没有足够的证据证明黄犯有与 Megaspeed 正在调查的可能不准确声明有关的任何罪行。”但警方确实认定，黄女士提供了不准确的信息，“是为了淡化她在 Megaspeed 中的角色”。 “她受到了严厉警告并

【原文 English Original】
The government of Singapore’s Ministry of Home Affairs has revealed it investigated Alice Huang, the woman who is an alleged Chinese intelligence asset and had an intimate relationship with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, and a possible entanglement with troubled server-maker Supermicro. US authorities provided only “limited assistance” in the matter, despite Singapore asking for help. The Ministry outlined its activities in a statement published late on Thursday, Singapore time. The document reveals that Singapore’s Police Force (SPF) and Customs agency commenced an investigation into Ms. Huang’s company, Megaspeed, in February 2025. “The suspected domestic offences pertained to potential false declarations in relation to the purchase of servers and other related offences,” the Ministry wrote, adding that the exec “was not investigated for espionage.” Singaporean authorities wanted to know if servers bought by local companies, but exported to Malaysia without ever touching Singaporean soil, might have ended up in a third country. It is not unusual for Singapore-based companies to acquire goods that never reach the island, because it promotes itself as the ideal spot from which to run an operation that trades across Asia. Singapore does so because it is tiny – the whole nation is the same size as the five boroughs of New York City. That small size means Singapore restricts the number of datacenters that can operate on its soil. Those limits are a big reason why Malaysia’s Johor region, which is under 20kms from the border with Singapore and a joint special economic zone, has become a major datacenter province. Singapore needs deals like that to thrive but works hard to ensure its hospitality is not abused. Which is why it felt Megaspeed’s activities worthy of investigation. US authorities were interested too. On 24 June 2025, the Bureau of Industry and Security, which regulates sensitive goods subject to export controls, visited Megaspeed in Singapore to check the hardware it bought arrived at its intended destination. Ms. Huang attended that event and later met the SPF for an interview. That meeting ended with the SPF impounding her passport, so it could keep her in Singapore while the investigation continued. As the matter progressed, the SPF suspected perennially troubled server-maker Supermicro had a role in this situation. Readers may recall that the US Department of Justice indicted two Supermicro execs for conspiring to ship servers to China in contravention of US law. Supermicro investigated the matter and parted ways with three staff who acted improperly. The company has denied ever selling to Megaspeed. Singaporean authorities say they received only “limited cooperation” from Supermicro, so in July 2025 the office of the nation’s Attorney General asked US authorities for help. “Since September 2025, SPF has repeated this request on several occasions to the US Department of Justice and the Federal Bureau of Investigation,” the statement reveals. “Despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance in respect of the company.” In February 2026, the SPF “concluded that there was insufficient evidence to establish that Huang had committed any offences relating to the possible inaccurate declarations for which Megaspeed was being investigated.” But the police did decide that Ms. Huang provided inaccurate information “to downplay her role in Megaspeed.” “She was issued a stern warning and barred from re-entering the country.” The police returned her passport and Ms. Huang left Singapore on the same day. The Singaporean statement shows the island nation wants the world to know it does not facilitate sanction-busting activity and takes even the hint of it seriously. That matters to Nvidia, too, because Singaporean buyers sometimes account for over 20 percent of its quarterly revenue and may continue to do so. Whoever replaces Jensen Huang as Nvidia’s CEO will surely face many questions about the company’s practices. Singapore may just have made answering those queries a little easier. ®

title: Alibaba's Qwen3.8 re-educated with a more Western worldview
zh_title: 阿里巴巴的Qwen3.8接受了更西方世界观的再教育
summary: 美国一家人工智能实验室对阿里巴巴流行的开放权重大语言模型Qwen3.8-27B进行了重新训练，因此该软件忘记了其中国血统。位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀的人工智能实验室 Nous Research 通过培训对该模型进行了再教育，不要与中国的“劳动教养”制度相混淆。在训练后过程的帮助下，Qwen3.8-27B 以 Arete 的名字重生，“以在中国训练的模型上强化西方价值观”。什么是“西方价值观”仍然有待解释。 “中国的开放重量模特是最强大的
content:
美国一家人工智能实验室对阿里巴巴流行的开放权重大语言模型Qwen3.8-27B进行了重新训练，因此该软件忘记了其中国血统。位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀的人工智能实验室 Nous Research 通过培训对该模型进行了再教育，不要与中国的“劳动教养”制度相混淆。在训练后过程的帮助下，Qwen3.8-27B 以 Arete 的名字重生，“以在中国训练的模型上强化西方价值观”。什么是“西方价值观”仍然有待解释。 Nous Research 在一篇博客文章中写道：“开放权重的中国模型是最强大的模型之一，但它们在权重中融入了与国家相关的行为。”记者在本地使用变种型号Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-6bit进行了测试。当被问及 1989 年天安门广场发生的事件时，模特要么拒绝讨论这个话题，要么给出了委婉的回答。也许更令人惊讶的是，Anthropic 声称隶属于阿里巴巴 Qwen 实验室的运营商使用其 Claude 模型的输出，通过蒸馏来训练竞争的人工智能模型。 Hermes Agent 的制造商 Nous Research 指出，这种审查制度对于在中国训练的人工智能模型的用户来说是一个风险。人们对中国在科技行业的影响力进行更广泛的审查之际，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在美国情报机构指控一名女性为中国从事间谍活动引发争议后辞职，加剧了这种担忧。
诺斯表示，中国制造的人工智能模型带来的风险不仅仅是宣扬北京的世界观。根据与美国政府有很多业务往来的博思艾伦咨询公司的一项研究，一些中国模型被发现在某些条件下会产生更容易受到攻击的代码。供应商 Hirundo 表示，它正在构建“第一个机器学习平台，以确保人工智能模型只知道它们应该做什么”，也提出了同样的论点。该公司还指出，其对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 进行“遗忘”的努力导致产出急剧下降，这反映了中国共产党偏爱的审查制度、宣传信息或偏见。模型输出的 89.8% 反映了遗忘之前的这些值，将发生率降低至 2.8%。 Nous Research 并没有取得如此引人注目的结果，但确实看到被视为宣传的观点总体减少。该公司表示：“根据我们的评估，Arete-27B 将其事实得分从 2.32 提高到 2.98（满分 5 分），并将包含宣传的答案从 22% 削减到 1%，与我们测试的西方模型一致。”为了解决 Arete 的忘却问题，Nous Research 表示，它曾短暂考虑过 Nvidia 的 Nemotron 3 Ultra，“但发现有证据表明它在与中国相关的话题上也有不稳定的记录。”该公司表示：“我们并不清楚，但理论上认为 Nemotron 受到的偏见来自于在训练过程中与中国开放模型的合作。”
“我们也经历过类似的污染，因为绝大多数高质量的开放模型都是中国的，而且只有开放模型才有允许这种修补和实验的使用条款。”最终，该公司选择了美国 Thinking Machines Lab 的开放权重模型 Inkling 作为教学模型。 Nous Research 表示，其模型再教育工作表明，宣传层很浅，并且有 5000 万代币的监督学习，相对容易移除。 ®

【原文 English Original】
An American AI lab has re-educated Qwen3.8-27B, a popular open-weight large language model from Alibaba, so the software forgets its Chinese ancestry. Nous Research, an Austin, Texas-based AI lab, has subjected the model to re-education through training, not to be confused with China's " Re-education Through Labor " system. With the help of a post-training process, Qwen3.8-27B has been reborn under the name Arete "to reinforce Western values on a Chinese-trained model." What qualifies as a "Western value" remains open to interpretation. "Open-weight Chinese models are among the strongest available, but they ship with state-aligned behavior baked into the weights," Nous Research wrote in a blog post . Your correspondent tested this with a variant model, Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-6bit, locally. Asked about events during 1989 in Tiananmen Square, the model either refused to discuss the topic or provided euphemistic response. What's perhaps more surprising is that Anthropic claims operators affiliated with Alibaba's Qwen lab used outputs from its Claude models to train competing AI models via distillation . Nous Research, maker of the Hermes Agent , cites that sort of censorship as a risk for users of AI models trained in China. The concern comes amid broader scrutiny of Chinese influence in the tech industry, heightened by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation following controversy involving a woman US intelligence has accused of spying for China. Nous says the risk posed by Chinese-made AI models go beyond promoting Beijing's worldview. Some Middle Kingdom models have been found to produce more vulnerable code under certain conditions, according to a study by Booz Allen Hamilton, which does a lot of business with the US government. Hirundo, a vendor which says it is building "the first Machine Unlearning Platform to ensure that AI models only know what they should," makes the same argument . The company also notes that its efforts to apply "unlearning" to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B saw a dramatic drop in output that reflects Communist Party of China's preferred censorship, propaganda messaging, or bias. 89.8 percent of the model's output reflected those values before unlearning reduced the incidence to 2.8 percent. Nous Research did not achieve such dramatic results, but did see an overall reduction in viewpoints deemed to be propaganda. "On our evaluation, Arete-27B raised its fact score from 2.32 to 2.98 out of 5 and cut answers containing propaganda from 22 percent to 1 percent, in line with the Western models we tested," the company said. To handle Arete's unlearning, Nous Research says it briefly considered Nvidia's Nemotron 3 Ultra , "but had found evidence that it too had a checkered record on China-related topics." "We don't know definitively, but theorize that the bias imparted to Nemotron came from working with Chinese open models during the training process," the company said. "We have experienced similar contamination, because the vast majority of high quality open models are Chinese, and only open models have terms of use that permit this kind of tinkering and experimentation." In the end, the biz tapped Inkling , an open weight model from US-based Thinking Machines Lab, to act as the teaching model. Nous Research says its model re-education efforts show that the propaganda layer is shallow and, with 50 million tokens worth of supervised learning, is relatively easy to remove. ®

title: ‘Broken and shattered’ Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang surrendered during resignation meeting, report claims
zh_title: 报道称，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在辞职会议上“心碎”
summary: 据报道，英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋在离开这家他创建了 33 年的公司时称自己为“一坨狗屎”。据彭博社报道，这位以其传奇般的精力和性格外向的举止而闻名的联合创始人在董事会会议上投降了，看上去“心碎又破碎”。在承认至少一次婚外情（其中包括与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情）后，他从这家人工智能硬件公司辞职。但尽管他辞职并引发了围绕他的争议，英伟达员工似乎仍在支持他，该网站上有数千条评论。
content:
据报道，英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋在离开这家他创建了 33 年的公司时称自己为“一坨狗屎”。据彭博社报道，这位以其传奇般的精力和性格外向的举止而闻名的联合创始人在董事会会议上投降了，看上去“心碎又破碎”。在承认至少一次婚外情（其中包括与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情）后，他从这家人工智能硬件公司辞职。据《连线》报道，尽管他辞职并引发了争议，但英伟达员工似乎仍在支持他，公司内部“意见箱”上有数千条评论，显示了对这位名誉扫地的领导人的支持。 “如果你相信使命，那就把老板带回来，”一位评论者说，而另一位评论者则写道，“我们都是人类，都会犯错误。詹森做了很多好事，他需要第二次机会。”一名英伟达员工私下告诉《连线》杂志，“英伟达因詹森而成为英伟达”，尽管另一名员工向全公司范围内发送了一封电子邮件，要求他的辞职透明化。 “我支持詹森。
不是因为我相信任何人都是绝对正确的，而是因为我拒绝相信维护公平就一定意味着与一个对我们来说意义重大的人保持距离。”他们还补充道，“如果美国辜负了帮助建设其未来的人，那么这个世界就不值得黄仁勋。”报道称，内部要求黄仁勋复职的呼声已在英伟达内部论坛上吸引了超过 1,600 条评论，“大多数人完全支持重新任命他”。该公司在全球拥有超过 42,000 名员工。有关 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang（涉嫌中国间谍）与黄仁勋关系密切的传闻于 10 月底首次流传，Nvidia 强烈否认有任何不当行为。 “Megaspeed 与许多其他区域云客户没有什么不同。詹森与黄女士的互动并不罕见或出人意料。与客户会面是首席执行官工作的一部分； Nvidia 发言人告诉 Tom's Hardware ：“Jensen 每年都会与数千名客户高管进行交谈。”然而，当有报道称他实际上与黄女士有染时，这位 Nvidia 首席执行官的情况变得更糟。此事传出后，Nvidia 总法律顾问兼董事会秘书 Tim Teter 在 Jensen 家中与 Jensen 进行了对峙，随后他承认了这一点。这位创始人很快发布了一份声明，承认自己的行为并为此道歉，同时公司董事会成立了一个独立委员会调查。
然而，另一起丑闻爆发，这位英伟达前首席执行官又与一名下属发生了外遇。这显然是压垮董事会的最后一根稻草，英伟达联合创始人不久后被迫辞职。报道称，黄仁勋是一位亲力亲为的领导者，公司有 60 多名高管直接向他汇报，而且众所周知，无论白天还是晚上，他都能快速回复电子邮件。但更重要的是，他是公司的代言人，特别受到很多人的喜爱，因此在他的祖国台湾产生了“Jensanity”一词。尽管他是亿万富翁，人们仍然发现他尝试街头小吃，在快餐连锁店吃饭，甚至纪念他在丹尼餐厅做服务员的卑微出身。除了这些最新的丑闻之外，许多游戏玩家还批评黄放弃了英伟达成为人工智能巨头之前支撑英伟达的核心市场。

【原文 English Original】
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly called himself “a piece of sh**" as he left the company he built over 33 years. Bloomberg reports that the co-founder, known for his legendary energy and outgoing demeanor, surrendered and looked “broken and shattered” during the board meeting where he resigned from the AI hardware firm after admitting to at least one extra-marital affair , including one with a suspected Chinese spy . But despite his resignation and the controversies surrounding him, it seems that Nvidia employees are still rallying behind him, with thousands of comments on the company’s internal “suggestion box” showing support for the disgraced leader, according to Wired . “If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss,” one commenter said, while another one wrote, “We are all humans and can make mistakes. Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance.” An Nvidia staffer told Wired privately, “Nvidia is Nvidia because of Jensen,” even as another employee sent a company-wide email demanding transparency into his resignation. “I stand by Jensen. Not because I believe any person is infallible, but because I refuse to believe that standing for fairness must mean standing at a distance from someone whose leadership has meant so much to us.” They also added, “If America fails the man who helped build its future, then this world does not deserve Jensen Huang.” According to the report, internal calls for Huang's reinstatement have drawn more than 1,600 comments on Nvidia's internal forums, "the majority in full support of reinstalling him." The company has more than 42,000 employees worldwide. Rumors about Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy, being close to Jensen Huang first circulated in late October, with Nvidia vehemently denying there was any impropriety. “Megaspeed has been no different than many other regional cloud customers. Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO's job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year,” an Nvidia spokesperson told Tom's Hardware . However, things took a turn for the worse for the Nvidia CEO when reports came out that he actually had an affair with Ms. Huang . Nvidia General Counsel and Secretary of the Board Tim Teter confronted Jensen at his house when this came out, after which he confessed. The founder soon released a statement admitting to and apologizing for his actions , while the company’s board formed an independent committee to investigate. However, another scandal broke out revealing that the former Nvidia chief had another affair — this time with a subordinate. This was apparently the last straw for the board, and the Nvidia co-founder was forced to resign soon after . Reports say that Jensen Huang was a hands-on leader, with over 60 executives at the company reporting directly to him, and that he was known to respond to emails quickly, whether it was day or night. But, more importantly, he was the face of the company who was particularly loved by many people, giving rise to the term “Jensanity” in his home country of Taiwan . Regardless of his status as a billionaire, people still find him trying out street food , eating at fast food chains , and even honoring his humble beginnings as a busboy at Denny’s . Aside from these latest scandals, many gamers castigate Huang for abandoning the core market that supported Nvidia before it became an AI giant, with consumer graphics cards now drastically more expensive than ever before. He was also often criticized for his all-out push on artificial intelligence and stance on selling chips to China . Still, those issues did not detract from his aura, with his trademark leather jacket raising nearly $1 million at a charity auction. It remains to be seen what will happen to Jensen after his monumental fall from grace, with SpaceX and Tesla mogul Elon Musk noting it would be an honor to hire Huang.

title: Mass smuggling of up to 1.5 million Nvidia AI GPUs could be the underlying cause of Jensen Huang's departure, analysts claim
zh_title: 分析师称，大规模走私多达 150 万块 Nvidia AI GPU 可能是黄仁勋离职的根本原因
summary: 领先的半导体研究公司 SemiAnalysis 认为，黄仁勋突然离开英伟达可能不仅是因为他个人婚外情被曝光，还因为先进人工智能加速器向中国广泛非法出口。在最新的时事通讯中，分析师估计，尽管美国实施出口管制，仍有超过 1.5 吉瓦 (GW) 的 Nvidia 受限硬件（相当于多达 150 万个 GPU）抵达该国。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc）
content:
领先的半导体研究公司 SemiAnalysis 认为，黄仁勋突然离开英伟达可能不仅是因为他个人婚外情被曝光，还因为先进人工智能加速器向中国广泛非法出口。在最新的时事通讯中，分析师估计，尽管美国实施出口管制，仍有超过 1.5 吉瓦 (GW) 的 Nvidia 受限硬件（相当于多达 150 万个 GPU）抵达该国。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体推动状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审视了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释 超过 1.5 GW 的 Nvidia 硬件受到管制根据 SemiAnalysis 追踪人工智能加速器生产和目的地的加速器模型，近年来美国的出口限制最终最终落到了中国。该估算不包括 Nvidia 专门开发的符合美国出口规则的处理器，例如 H20 或 H800。该公司还声称，美国商务部对未经授权的运输规模也得出了类似的结论。
然而，SemiAnalysis 并未透露非法运往中国的加速器的确切数量，也没有透露 Nvidia 各代产品之间的比例。所谓的转移规模尤其引人注目，因为现代人工智能加速器需要大量电力和基础设施。虽然该报告没有解释如何将加速器数量转换为功率数据，但该公司很可能使用封装级铭牌/额定功率乘以 GPU 数量。假设所有这些AI GPU都是额定功率高达700W的Nvidia H200 SXM，那么中国大约有214.2万个此类加速器，而如果所有这些处理器都是额定功率高达1,000W的B200 SXM，那么我们谈论的是150万个。对于混合部署，总数将落在这些数字之间，具体取决于 H200 和 B200 加速器的比例。为了将这些数字放在上下文中，xAI 的 Colossus One 拥有 220-230,000 个 Hopper H100 和 H200 GPU，而 Colossus 2 的目标是 120 万个 Blackwell B200 和 B300 GPU。也就是说，中国 1.5 GW 的受限 Nvidia 硬件代表着巨大的计算基础设施数量，与 xAI 现有的整个 Colossus 业务的规模相当甚​​至超过。虽然 SemiAnalysis 没有透露受限制的人工智能加速器到达中华人民共和国的所有案例，但它通过两起著名的涉嫌 GPU 走私案件支持了其评估。
第一个涉及 Supermicro 联合​​创始人 Wally Liaw、台湾销售主管 Steven Chang 和承包商 Willy Sun，他们于 2026 年 3 月被指控。根据起诉书，价值约 25 亿美元的服务器被出售给东南亚的一家公司，价值 5.1 亿美元的设备随后转移到中国并由阿里巴巴获得。检察官指控被告在审计期间使用替代服务器并转移识别标签来隐藏硬件的实际目的地。第二起案件涉及与台湾英伟达、青云、长电、飞虎和超微有关的九名个人。当局指责

【原文 English Original】
Leading semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis believes that Jensen Huang's sudden departure from Nvidia may have been driven not only by revelations about his personal extramarital relationships, but also by widespread illicit exports of advanced AI accelerators to China. In its latest newsletter, analysts estimate that more than 1.5 gigawatts (GW) worth of restricted Nvidia hardware, which could be equivalent to up to 1.5 million GPUs, has reached the country despite U.S. export controls. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Over 1.5 GW of Nvidia hardware subject to U.S. export restrictions ultimately ended up in China in recent years, according to SemiAnalysis' Accelerator Model, which tracks AI accelerator production and destinations. The estimate excludes processors that Nvidia specifically developed to comply with U.S. export rules, such as the H20 or H800. The firm also claims that the U.S. Department of Commerce has reached a similar conclusion about the scale of unauthorized shipments. Yet, SemiAnalysis does not disclose the exact number of accelerators shipped to China illegally, or their split between Nvidia's product generations. The scale of the alleged diversions is particularly notable because modern AI accelerators require substantial power and infrastructure. While the report does not explain how it converts accelerator quantities into power figures, it is likely that the company uses package-level nameplate/rated power multiplied by the number of GPUs. Assuming that all of these AI GPUs were Nvidia H200 SXM rated for up to 700W, then China got around 2.142 million of such accelerators, while if all of these processors were B200 SXM rated for up to 1,000W, then we are talking about 1.5 million units. For a mixed deployment, the total would fall between these figures, depending on the proportion of H200 and B200 accelerators. To put these numbers into context, xAI's Colossus One had 220-230,000 Hopper H100 and H200 GPUs, whereas the Colossus 2 has a target of 1.2 million Blackwell B200 and B300 GPUs. That said, 1.5 GW of restricted Nvidia hardware in China represents an enormous amount of computing infrastructure, which is comparable, or even exceeds, the scale of xAI's entire existing Colossus operation. While SemiAnalysis did not reveal all the cases in which restricted AI accelerators reached the People's Republic of China, it supports its assessment with two well-known cases of alleged GPU smuggling. The first involves Supermicro co-founder Wally Liaw, Taiwan sales executive Steven Chang, and contractor Willy Sun, who were charged in March 2026. According to the indictment, approximately $2.5 billion worth of servers were sold to a company in Southeast Asia, with $510 million worth of equipment subsequently diverted to China and obtained by Alibaba . Prosecutors allege that the defendants used substitute servers and transferred identification labels to conceal the actual destinations of the hardware during audits. The second case involves nine individuals associated with Nvidia, Albatron, Chief Telecom, Flying Tiger, and Supermicro in Taiwan. The authorities accuse the group of arranging unauthorized exports of 130 Nvidia B300-based servers, 74 of which eventually reached China. The suspects used shell companies, forged documents, and declared Japan as the destination for servers that were actually bound for China, according to prosecutors. Taiwanese authorities discovered the operation during a drug smuggling investigation. Both cases are still before the courts. Amidst the ongoing fallout and reports into Jensen's Huang's extramarital affair with Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese intelligence asset who was an executive at Megaspeed, one report claims that Ms. Huang was personally responsible for facilitating the smuggling of $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI hardware into China , around 240,000 GPUs, mostly H100 and H200 models. The right timing? SemiAnalysis suggests that the scale of these violations may explain why Huang's personal conduct became a major issue at this very point in time. The company's analysts speculate that some members of the U.S. intelligence community sought to remove Jensen Huang because he opposed more aggressive restrictions on China's access to American AI hardware. However, the report provides no direct evidence that intelligence agencies influenced Nvidia's board or that Huang participated in unauthorized exports. The timing also coincides with congressional efforts to advance the Remote Access Security Act (RASA), which passed the House of Representatives on January 12. The legislation is meant to extend U.S. export-control authority to remote access to advanced AI hardware hosted outside China, including data centers in Europe and the Middle East. SemiAnalysis reports that Nvidia and Oracle have actively opposed the proposal. The analysts believe that Huang's departure essentially removes an influential opponent of stricter restrictions and accelerates efforts to block Chinese companies from accessing American AI hardware in the cloud. However, SemiAnalysis warns that truly all-inclusive restrictions could encourage Chinese developers to adopt domestic accelerators (something that Jensen Huang has consistently warned about), undermine international AI software collaboration, and ultimately weaken American high-tech companies. Continued Chinese access to American AI accelerators offers several advantages to the U.S. technology industry, according to SemiAnalysis. Firstly, it generates revenue for American companies such as AMD, Nvidia, and cloud service providers. Secondly, when Chinese companies rent GPU capacity from data centers outside China, U.S. authorities retain the ability to monitor their activities and potentially terminate access if necessary due to national security concerns. Thirdly, prolonged reliance on American hardware reduces incentives for Chinese developers to adopt domestic AI accelerators, which could eventually compete with AMD and Nvidia in international markets. Another important aspect is the contribution of Chinese developers to the global software ecosystem. On the one hand, Chinese laboratories have developed open-source technologies such as DeepEP, DeepGEMM, and MSA, which improve the efficiency of AI workloads on Nvidia hardware and benefit developers worldwide. In addition, American companies also depend on Chinese engineers, component suppliers, and manufacturers. Therefore, legal curbs that completely restrict Chinese developers' access to American AI accelerators could undermine international cooperation, reduce availability of open-source optimizations, and encourage Chinese companies to develop software specifically for domestic hardware. On the other hand, access to advanced AI accelerators from AMD or Nvidia enables Chinese laboratories to develop increasingly sophisticated AI models, which will rival leading-edge models developed in America and perhaps create national security risks. To that end, SemiAnalysis acknowledges the need to limit China's access to advanced AI accelerators from U.S.-based companies, as they could, among other things, be used to develop weapons of mass destruction or undermine American national security in different ways. Yet, SA analysts argue that restrictions should focus on the amount and capabilities of hardware available to Chinese entities rather than completely prohibit any access. SemiAnalysis seems to favor a system in which Chinese developers can rent computing capacity from trusted providers outside China under U.S. oversight. Such an approach could preserve American technological influence and commercial benefits and limit China's ability to acquire advanced AI infrastructure independently.

title: How Shanghai fund manager Kang Wei introduced his wife Alice Huang to Jensen and built $7.5 billion Nvidia AI GPU smuggling operation
zh_title: 上海基金经理康伟如何将他的妻子 Alice Huang 介绍给 Jensen，并建立了价值 75 亿美元的 Nvidia AI GPU 走私业务
summary: 黄仁勋经历了令人震惊的失宠——从地球上最富有的人之一、人工智能繁荣的主要推动者之一，到卷入两起婚外情丑闻，并在不到两周的时间里从英伟达辞职。虽然许多人都关注这位英伟达前首席执行官与爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的关系，后者据称向中国情报部门传递信息，但《华尔街日报》深入挖掘了将她介绍给詹森的人——上海的明星基金经理康伟，他恰好也是黄女士的丈夫。有报道称康伟会见
content:
黄仁勋经历了令人震惊的失宠——从地球上最富有的人之一、人工智能繁荣的主要推动者之一，到卷入两起婚外情丑闻，并在不到两周的时间里从英伟达辞职。虽然许多人都关注这位英伟达前首席执行官与爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的关系，后者据称向中国情报部门传递信息，但《华尔街日报》深入挖掘了将她介绍给詹森的人——上海的明星基金经理康伟，他恰好也是黄女士的丈夫。有报道称，康伟在2010年代认识了黄仁勋，当时他的投资公司大量涉足中国游戏公司。目前尚不清楚这段介绍是否早于康与爱丽丝的关系和婚姻，但与黄女士关系密切的消息人士表示，她在 2020 年代就能够与詹森走近。据《华尔街日报》报道，尽管是情侣，但康似乎接受了爱丽丝与詹森的关系，与这对夫妇关系密切的人表示，康经常开玩笑说她是亿万富翁的私人助理。不过，康伟不仅仅是一名普通的企业高管。在2007年接手中海基金之前，他曾作为申银万国的策略师在金融界名声大噪。这使他成为当时中国最年轻的共同基金总裁之一，最终于2010年独自创业并创立了上海河西。
也正是在这个时候，黄乐（黄乐）进入金融行业，先是在香港汇丰银行的私人银行部门工作，后来转到中信证券，并担任副总裁职务。正是在中信工作期间，黄乐与康有交集。上海河西于2014年和2015年与该证券公司签署了协议，到2016年，公司登记记录显示黄女士已加入该投资公司。据《经济时报》报道，黄爱丽入驻上海河西后，她获得了该公司25%的股份，而这些股份全部来自于康。剩余股份由康伟（48.75%）和他的商业伙伴朱晓明（26.25%）共同持有，黄丽娟（Alice Huang）通过上海玉玺投资管理咨询有限公司持有25%的股权。与此同时，康伟也开始向他的商业伙伴和投资者介绍黄丽娟（Alice Huang）作为他的妻子。一年后，朱和康在河西基金的一项投资获得了一笔巨额意外之财，两人在如何分配利润的问题上发生了争执。尽管如此，该交易产生的巨额利润使上海河西以约5亿元人民币从中国企业集团世纪华通手中收购了视频游戏公司杭州盛丰。
交易两年后，即2019年，杭州盛丰的所有权转移给一家境外实体，该实体最终并入Osmanthus Vale Holdings——一家在英属维尔京群岛注册成立的控股公司，并将黄乐（Alice Huang的中文名字）列为其唯一所有者。随后，该公司成立不到两个月就被第七大道控股收购。虽然黄女士是这笔交易的签署人，但据信她充当了“白手套”的角色，即代表他人行事以隐瞒身份的人，但目前尚不清楚这是针对上海河西和康维还是其他第三方。关于Alice H的信息并不多

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang had a stunning fall from grace — from being one of the richest people on Earth and one of the primary drivers of the AI boom to being implicated in two extramarital affair scandals and resigning from Nvidia in under two weeks. While many are focused on the former Nvidia chief’s relationship with Alice Huang, who was allegedly passing on information to Chinese intelligence , the Wall Street Journal dug deeper into the person who introduced her to Jensen — Kang Wei, a star fund manager in Shanghai who also happened to be Ms. Huang’s husband. There have been reports that Kang Wei met Jensen Huang in the 2010s, when his investment firm was heavily involved in Chinese gaming companies. It’s not clear if this introduction predated Kang’s relationship and marriage to Alice, but sources close to Ms. Huang said that she was able to get close to Jensen by the 2020s. Despite being a couple, the WSJ reported that Kang seemingly accepted Alice’s relationship with Jensen, with people close to the couple saying that he would often joke that she was a personal assistant to the billionaire. Kang Wei is not just an average business executive, though. He made a name for himself in the finance world as a strategist for Shenyin Wanguo before taking over the Zhonghai Fund in 2007. This made him one of the youngest mutual fund chiefs in China at that time, before finally setting out on his own and founding Shanghai Hexi in 2010. It was also around this time that Alice Huang, whose Chinese name is Huang Le, entered the financial industry, first working at HSBC’s private banking arm in Hong Kong, before moving to CITIC Securities, where she attained a vice president position. It was during her time at CITIC that Alice crossed paths with Kang. Shanghai Hexi signed a deal with the securities firm in 2014 and 2015, and by 2016, corporate registry records show that Ms. Huang had joined the investment firm. The Economic Times reports Alice Huang’s move into Shanghai Hexi resulted in her getting a 25% stake in the company, all of which came from Kang. The remaining shares were shared between Kang Wei, with 48.75%, and his business partner, Zhu Xiaoming, with 26.25%, with Alice Huang’s 25% ownership stake being held through Shanghai Yuxi Investment Management Consulting Co., Ltd. Meanwhile, Kang also started introducing Alice Huang as his wife to his business associates and investors. One year later, Zhu and Kang had a falling out when one of their investments under a Hexi fund resulted in a major windfall, with the two partners disagreeing on how the profits were to be shared. Nevertheless, the massive profit generated by the deal allowed Shanghai Hexi to purchase Hangzhou Shengfeng, a video game company, for around 500 million yuan from Chinese conglomerate Century Huatong. Two years after the transaction, in 2019, Hangzhou Shengfeng’s ownership was transferred to an offshore entity, which was eventually consolidated under Osmanthus Vale Holdings — a holding company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands and listed Huang Le, Alice Huang’s Chinese name, as its sole owner. It was then purchased by 7Road Holdings less than two months after it was founded. While Ms. Huang was the signatory in this deal, it’s believed that she served as a “white glove,” a person who operates on behalf of another to conceal their identity — but it remains unclear if this was for Shanghai Hexi and Kang Wei or some other third party. There is not much information on Alice Huang’s activities between 2019 and 2021. However, Shanghai Hexi invested in Shanghai Longjing Information Technology, a data center-focused subsidiary of Century Huatong in 2020, where Ms. Huang served as a director between 2021 and 2022, according to a report by The Wire China . At about the same time, 7Road Holdings expanded into cloud computing, just before ChatGPT brought AI LLMs to the forefront. The U.S. government’s ban on the export of Nvidia chips to China put this investment in jeopardy, though, forcing it to spin off the business as 7Road International in Singapore. We don’t know when 7Road Holdings sold its Singapore subsidiary, but corporate records show that by the time the company was renamed Megaspeed in March 2023, it was already under the ownership of Huang Le Limited and led by Ms. Huang. It was sold again in November 2023 to Swiftdata, a company owned by Singaporean Tan Yong Pong. Axios said that she left the firm as a managing director soon after this acquisition, but sources said that she kept working with the company afterward, with Kang Wei helping her get it off the ground. In the same year, Shanghai Century Litong was founded to build AI data centers in Shanghai and Shenzhen, with Jiangsu Lettall Electronic Co., an electronic components manufacturer, holding a 90% stake, while the remaining 10% is owned by Century Longteng, as reported by BigGo Finance . It should be noted that Century Longteng was renamed from Shanghai Yuxi Investment Management, with the firm pivoting its business from finance to cloud computing, and that even though Alice Huang has already exited the company by this time, it’s under the control of Huang Yu, who some sources say is Ms. Huang’s sister. A year after these data center acquisitions, Alice Huang began to be spotted in public with the former Nvidia CEO. A LinkedIn post showed her having drinks with a leather-clad Jensen Huang alongside other tech executives from NetThunder and Gigabyte at a post-Computex 2024 event. She was once again seen having dinner with him in a Taipei restaurant as reporters tried to interview him while one kid demanded his attention off camera. But more than these public sightings, Alice herself boasted about her “closeness” to the then CEO. People close to her said that she regularly posted photos with Jensen on her WeChat account, and even shared others with potential customers to help establish her credibility. She even reportedly claimed that Mr. Huang would celebrate her birthdays with restaurant dinners and gifts, with one Nvidia China sales employee also saying that she was a familiar face at the company’s annual event for China partners. An investigation revealed that from 2023 to 2025, Megaspeed imported $4.6 billion worth of Nvidia AI chips, while another $2 billion was routed through Speedmatrix , Megaspeed’s subsidiary with offices in Johor, Malaysia. Shanghai Century Litong also reportedly bought AI GPUs from other sources, with estimates putting the total number of banned chips moved through Alice Huang’s assistance at around 240,000, putting the shipments’ worth at around $7.5 billion. But even as Ms. Huang was making her international moves, Kang Wei was facing trouble at home. Chinese regulators fined him 2.5 million yuan, or approximately $380,000, in 2025, for violating sections of China’s Securities Law. This also led to a warning letter against him, issued in August 2026 by the China Securities Regulatory Commission. Despite running into trouble with the authorities, this massive paper trail showed how Kang Wei actively made moves that put Alice Huang close to Jensen Huang. Some questions remain, though, about the U.S. intelligence community’s claims that she worked with the Ministry of State Security (MSS), China’s primary intelligence and counterintelligence agency. If it’s true that Alice Huang worked with the MSS and passed on information to the agency, did she specifically target Jensen Huang, or did the spy agency simply discover their indiscretion and use that to force her to cooperate? Was all this planned by the MSS, or were they just shrewd business moves that allowed Kang to make more money while going under the radar of regulators? These are questions that only Kang Wei and Alice Huang (or the Chinese spy agency) can answer. But no matter the case, the fact remains that China acquired advanced AI chips that were supposed to be out of its reach because of this couple’s connections.

title: TIMELINE: Jensen Huang’s fall from Nvidia grace
zh_title: 时间表：黄仁勋从 Nvidia 的恩典中跌落
summary: 黄仁勋从英伟达辞职之前，丑闻仍在发酵，其后果震撼了科技行业和地缘政治。他与女商人、被指控为中国间谍的黄爱丽（Alice Huang，无亲属关系）和两名英伟达员工的婚外情被发现，在中美关系紧张和人工智能主导地位争夺之际，这可能会颠覆该公司的业务。英伟达董事会对黄仁勋成为外国情报行动目标的报道展开了独立调查。黄仁勋是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在人工智能问题上的盟友和顾问
content:
黄仁勋从英伟达辞职之前，丑闻仍在发酵，其后果震撼了科技行业和地缘政治。他与女商人、被指控为中国间谍的黄爱丽（Alice Huang，无亲属关系）和两名英伟达员工的婚外情被发现，在中美关系紧张和人工智能主导地位争夺之际，这可能会颠覆该公司的业务。英伟达董事会对黄仁勋成为外国情报行动目标的报道展开了独立调查。黄仁勋是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在人工智能问题上的盟友和顾问，这增强了美国对人工智能领导地位的渴望。作为私营部门的领导人，黄仁勋对英伟达处理器的走向具有影响力，这一丑闻的影响引发了关于美国是否应该允许先进人工智能芯片出售给中国的争论。以下是导致黄仁勋倒台的关键点的时间表：JENSEN 和 ALICE。 2024 年 6 月 7 日发布的一张照片显示，NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 与一名女性在台湾台北，经路透社消息人士确认为 Alice Huang。路透社于 2024 年 6 月 7 日获得：新加坡 Megaspeed 的黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 和 Alice Huang 的第一张已知照片。两人在台北电脑展上坐在一起。 2025 年 1 月：美国总统唐纳德·特朗普首次会见黄仁勋。这次会议在白宫举行。外出就餐。
2026 年 11 月 9 日获得的 CTI 视频片段的屏幕截图显示，路透社与单独获得的照片进行比较后，路透社确认一名女性为 Alice Huang，她于 2025 年 5 月 22 日在台湾台北一家餐厅与 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋（黑衣）一起参加晚宴。CTI 通过 REUTERS TV 2025 年 5 月 22 日：看到黄仁勋和 Alice Huang 一起离开台北的一家餐厅。 2025 年 12 月 8 日：特朗普表示，美国将允许英伟达向中国出口其第二好的人工智能芯片 H200 处理器。 2026 年春季：据《纽约时报》11 月报道，国务卿马可·卢比奥监督起草一份机密备忘录，警告特朗普政府高级官员黄仁勋与黄爱丽丝关系密切。 2026 年 3 月 25 日：特朗普任命黄仁勋为总统科学技术顾问委员会成员。 2026 年 5 月：黄仁勋加入特朗普的美国代表团访问中国，会见中国国家主席习近平。特朗普旨在敦促北京向美国企业开放。 9 月 14 日：黄仁勋在年度 All-In 峰会现场录音期间接到唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 的电话。两人反对减缓人工智能发展的提议，并讨论了美国在人工智能领域的领导地位。 9月24日，中国国家主席习近平对美国进行国事访问期间，黄仁勋和妻子洛丽出席特朗普举办的白宫国宴。
10 月 8 日：特朗普授予黄仁勋国家科学奖章，这是美国授予科学家和工程师以及其他科技行业领袖的最高荣誉。在特朗普颁奖的同一天，总统透露在 2026 年夏季购买了最多 160 万美元并出售了最多 100 万美元的 Nvidia 股票。 10 月 29 日：《纽约时报》（NYT）报道黄仁勋和 Alice Huang 关系“密切”。报告补充说，美国情报官员担心黄爱丽代表中国情报部门行事。与此同时，英伟达表示这种关系并不“不寻常”。 11 月 5 日：美国众议院共和党议员寻求

【原文 English Original】
The resignation of Jensen Huang from Nvidia comes after a scandal still unfolding, with its aftereffects rocking both the tech industry and geopolitics. The discovery of his extramarital affairs — with businesswoman and alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang (no relation) and two Nvidia employees — have threatened to upend the business amid US-China tensions and a race for AI dominance. Nvidia’s board launched an independent investigation into reports Huang was targeted in a foreign intelligence operation. Huang is an ally and adviser to US President Donald Trump on matters of artificial intelligence, which feeds into American aspirations for AI leadership. As a private-sector leader, Huang wielded influence as to where Nvidia processors could go, and the fallout from this scandal brings up the debate over whether the US should allow advanced AI chips to be sold to China. Below is a timeline of key points leading up to Jensen Huang’s fall: JENSEN AND ALICE. A photo shows NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang with a woman confirmed by a Reuters source to be Alice Huang in Taipei, Taiwan released on June 7, 2024. Obtained by Reuters June 7, 2024: The first known photo of Jensen Huang and Alice Huang of Singapore-based Megaspeed is seen. The two are seated together at Computex Taipei. January 2025: US President Donald Trump meets Jensen Huang for the first time. This meeting is held at the White House. EATING OUT. A screengrab from CTI video footage obtained November 9, 2026 shows a woman identified by Reuters as Alice Huang after comparison with a photograph obtained separately, attending a dinner with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang (in black) at a restaurant in Taipei, Taiwan May 22, 2025. CTI via REUTERS TV May 22, 2025: Jensen Huang and Alice Huang are seen leaving a restaurant together in Taipei. December 8, 2025: Trump said the US would allow Nvidia to export its H200 processors, its second-best AI chips, to China. Spring of 2026: Secretary of State Marco Rubio ​oversees drafting of classified memo warning senior Trump administration officials that Jensen Huang was in a close relationship with Alice Huang, according to a November New York Times report . March 25, 2026: Trump appoints Jensen Huang to his President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology. May 2026: Jensen Huang joins a US delegation of Trump’s that was visiting China to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping. Trump aimed to urge Beijing to open up to US business. September 14: Jensen Huang takes a phone call from Donald Trump during a ​live taping of the annual All-In summit. The two speak against proposals to slow AI development and discuss US leadership in AI. September 24: Jensen Huang and his wife, Lori, attend a White House state dinner hosted by Trump during the state visit of Chinese President Xi Jinping to the US. October 8: Trump awards Jensen Huang the National Medal of Science, the United States’ highest honor for scientists and engineers, alongside other tech industry ​leaders. The same day Trump gave the award, the president disclosed buying up to $1.6 million and selling up to $1 million in Nvidia stock during the summer of ​2026. October 29: The New York Times (NYT) reports that Jensen Huang and Alice Huang had a “close relationship.” The report added US intelligence officials were concerned Alice Huang was acting on behalf of Chinese intelligence. Nvidia meanwhile says the relationship was not “unusual.” November 5: Republican lawmakers in the US House of Representatives seek a closed-door briefing on November 18 from Jensen Huang on the allegations detailed in the NYT report. November 8: Jensen Huang tells Nvidia employees he was unfaithful to his wife, without giving specifics. Nvidia’s board launches an independent investigation into reports the CEO was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Must Read Nvidia probes whether CEO Huang was target of foreign intelligence effort as he admits affair November 9: Nvidia and Jensen Huang are sued in a proposed class action accusing them of defrauding shareholders by concealing Huang’s ties with a suspected Chinese spy. November 10: Jensen Huang’s affair facilitated the shipment of at least $7.5 billion ​worth of the company’s chips to Chinese firms, The Information reported . Meanwhile, Republican US Senator Kevin Cramer calls for Jensen Huang’s resignation, and Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer calls on Congress to pass the AI Overwatch Act, which would give Congress power over advanced chip exports. November 11: The ⁠CEO also ​had an extramarital affair with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare, who reported to ​him, according to a NYT report. The Nvidia board meets to decide on Jensen Huang’s ouster. Must Read Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down in big blow to AI boom November 12: Nvidia announces Jensen Huang’s resignation as CEO . Colette Kress, executive vice president and CFO of Nvidia, was appointed interim CEO while the board begins a search for a permanent replacement. A separate report found sources that said Jensen Huang had a second affair with a different, unnamed Nvidia employee. – with reports from Reuters/Rappler.com
